settings.label: Initial Audit

settings.label: Design / Develop
settings.text: Our team brings the strategy to life through high-converting design and seamless development, so the site looks great, works flawlessly, and is built to drive results.

settings.label: Test
settings.text: A/B tests, heatmaps, and user behavior analysis validate each change before it goes site-wide, refining the experience for maximum impact.

settings.label: Analyze
settings.text: Data doesn’t lie. We track conversions, read the results, and surface the insights that fine-tune your store’s effectiveness for consistent growth.

settings.label: Implement

settings.title: Stop guessing, start knowing
settings.body: Without A/B testing, every design change or marketing decision is a gamble. Testing replaces guesswork with data-backed insights, so every change you ship is one you can prove.

settings.title: Data-driven growth that goes beyond conversions
settings.body: Our approach goes beyond conversion rate. We focus on the KPIs that drive sustainable growth: average order value, lifetime value, and engagement metrics like bounce rate, pages per session, and session duration. The best CRO strategies don’t just increase sales, they create experiences that keep customers coming back.

settings.title: Engage customers with strategic Shopify design
settings.body: A well-designed store does more than look good. It keeps visitors engaged longer and raises conversion potential. We craft designs that present information clearly while reinforcing your brand, using design as a conversion tool that lays the foundation for growth and retention.

settings.question: Is the first test really free?
settings.answer: Yes. Your first A/B test is completely free, no strings attached. It's our way of showing the value of optimization before you commit to anything. The only cost is a monthly subscription to the A/B testing Shopify tool we use.

settings.question: How much traffic does my store need to run A/B tests?
settings.answer: We typically recommend at least 30,000 monthly visitors to ensure results reach statistical significance. If you're under that, we can still help with other CRO strategies like heatmaps, user testing, or a design audit.

settings.question: Do I need to sign a long-term contract?
settings.answer: A/B testing is an ongoing process. It requires consistent iteration to drive meaningful results. That said, not everything needs a long-term commitment. We offer flat-rate pricing for one-time services like landing page design or a CRO audit if you just need a starting point.

settings.question: How long do tests take?
settings.answer: Test duration depends on your traffic. Higher-traffic stores can reach meaningful results in as little as 1–2 weeks, while lower-traffic stores may take longer. We'll help you prioritize what to test and when.
